latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fuse bind and first step into one CGO crossing by @mattn in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1455
* Fuse step and column fetch into one CGO crossing in Next by @mattn in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1460
* fix: release replaced authorizer callbacks by @ryanchou1994 in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1458
* Return an error instead of crashing when a connection is used after Close by @mattn in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1462
* Report missing arguments when Exec has no arguments by @laodouya in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1471
* Upgrade SQLite to version 3540100 by @mattn in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1472

## New Contributors
* @ryanchou1994 made their first contribution in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1458
* @laodouya made their first contribution in https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1471

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/compare/v1.14.52...v1.14.53
